handwork.validation: /test-dev desktop runs PandaDoc Search from the working tree with live reload (npm run dev — quit the installed copy first); /test-prod desktop when a change needs checking bundled with DevTools, /test-release desktop to see it exactly as it ships.
handwork.deploy: /deploy-desktop bumps the version, signs, notarizes and publishes the Mac app to this repo's GitHub Releases (npm run release); installed copies auto-update, and the pushed v* tag builds the Windows installer in GitHub Actions.
